title: GPTPro bundle MANIFEST.json
$comment: Ships INSIDE each bundle zip, at <bundle>/MANIFEST.json. Its consumer is the external model. It answers the only question that separates 'the repo does not contain this' from 'this was withheld from me': what scope was declared, what was staged, what was dropped and under whose policy.

authority.$comment: The boundary is published in the artifact itself so a reader cannot mistake a packaging receipt for a design verdict.

dirty.$comment: null means PROJECT_ROOT is not a git worktree, which is NOT the same as clean.

dirty_inventory_sha256.$comment: sha256 over the sorted `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall` lines. A commit SHA alone describes a dirty tree accurately and about the wrong object; this pins which drift.

sources.$comment: The literal dir:/file: declarations from bundles.conf, with their required/optional disposition. A source that was absent is listed here with present=false; silence is not an option.

files.$comment: MANIFEST.json is deliberately absent from this list: a file cannot carry its own hash. Its hash lives in handoff_receipt.json, outside the zip.

repo_path.$comment: path relative to PROJECT_ROOT; `file:` sources may be re-homed by their :subdir, so the two differ and both are needed to re-anchor a citation

kind.$comment: Coarse routing hint for a reader, never a gate input.

exclusions.$comment: Rolled up by (pattern, policy_source). Per-file paths are intentionally NOT here: what a reader is owed about a withheld file is that it exists, not its name. The operator's receipt keeps the full list.

policy_source.$comment: tool_global = the export tool's own default; project_config = this repo decided it; source_decl = one bundle's own declaration, usually because a sibling bundle carries that scope.

missing_sources.$comment: Required sources that were absent. A non-empty list means the export aborted, so a published manifest always has this empty — it is present so the field cannot be confused with 'not checked'.

derived_views.$comment: Any generated index shipped alongside the raw files. Each row binds to its backing hashes and is authority=screen_only: a derived view is a presentation, never a sign-off surface.

coverage.$comment: pcb-agent/skills/_shared/coverage-gate.md: scanned + excluded == eligible, violations <= scanned, scanned <= eligible. scanned == 0 is NO_COVERAGE, never GREEN.
